type: string (base64 on Bedrock, file upload on v2beta)
summary: Carries the source image for reference-driven generation. Lixpi resolves the selected workspace reference into bytes, uploads it to the matching direct Stability control endpoint, or base64-encodes it for Bedrock image-to-image; it is not a scalar composer setting.
combines: On direct Stability requests, one style or structure reference becomes the image multipart field on the matching control endpoint.
On Bedrock, the same primary reference becomes image and requires mode=image-to-image plus a pipeline-owned strength.
Two-reference direct style transfer uses init_image and style_image instead. Bedrock has no equivalent two-image route and drops the separate style reference.
note: Populated internally from the resolved provider-neutral reference; not shown as a model configuration control.

usage.from: the first resolved provider-neutral image reference
usage.what: Supplies the input image for direct style or structure control and for the Bedrock image-to-image fallback.
